IMPORTANT: REGISTRATION & FEE DETAILS

  • Registration & Idea Submission: 100% FREE.
  • Virtual Idea Presentation Round: 100% FREE.
  • Offline Grand Finale: ₹1,500 per shortlisted team, payable only after selection to confirm participation. This covers food and accommodation arrangements.

No payment is required during initial registration, idea submission or the virtual round.

Have Questions About CIH 4.0?

For queries, doubts, clarifications or assistance, join our official WhatsApp Participants' Group.

Join WhatsApp Group:
https://chat.whatsapp.com/GcSt2hlhnnd7RZG4K0BYY0?s=sw&p=i&mlu=4&ilr=4&iam=2

Event Overview

Central India Hackathon 4.0 (CIH 4.0) is a National-Level Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon organized by Suryodaya College of Engineering & Technology (SCET), Nagpur, and Suryodaya Technology Business Incubation Foundation (STBIF).

Building on the success of CIH 1.0, 2.0 and 3.0, this edition brings together students, developers, innovators and researchers from across India to develop technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges.

CIH 4.0 aims to create history by attempting to establish a record for the Largest Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon, seeking recognition from the International Book of Records.

Event Highlights

  • Category: National-Level Deep-Tech Hackathon
  • Mode: Hybrid (Virtual + Offline)
  • Team Size: Exactly 4 Members
  • Grand Finale Duration: 24 Hours
  • Grand Finale Dates: 22-23 January 2027
  • Venue: SCET, Nagpur, Maharashtra
  • Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000 + Goodies
  • Special Initiative: International Book of Records attempt

Technology Domains

CIH 4.0 focuses on five emerging technology domains:

  1. AI & Cognitive Systems: Advanced AI, Agentic Intelligence and Intelligent Systems.

  2. Robotics & Automation: Autonomous Systems, Advanced Robotics and Intelligent Automation.

  3. Semiconductors & Embedded Technologies: Edge Computing, Embedded Intelligence and Cyber-Physical Systems.

  4. SpaceTech & Defence: Aerospace, Space Technology and Strategic Technologies.

  5. Biotechnology & Healthcare: Biomedical Engineering and Life Sciences.

Participants can identify real-world challenges and develop innovative, scalable solutions within these domains.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Open to students from AICTE-approved and other recognized colleges and universities across India.

  • Exactly 4 members per team.

  • Interdisciplinary teams and teams comprising students from different colleges are welcome.

  • Students from technical and non-technical backgrounds can participate.

  • All team members must be registered under the same team.

Why Participate?

  • Be part of an International Book of Records attempt.
  • Explore advanced Deep-Tech domains.
  • Receive mentorship from industry experts and domain specialists.
  • Develop functional prototypes during a 24-hour hackathon.
  • Compete for prizes worth ₹1,00,000+.
  • Gain national-level recognition.
  • Network with innovators, entrepreneurs and technology enthusiasts.

Hackathon Format & Timeline

The hackathon will be conducted in three phases.

Phase 1: Registration & Idea Submission

Registration Period: 1 November - 30 November 2026

  • Register your team on Unstop.
  • Select a real-world problem aligned with any of the five technology domains.
  • Develop an innovative solution approach.
  • Prepare and submit a PPT explaining your proposed solution.
  • Download the mandatory official CIH 4.0 PPT Template from the Brief/Case or Download Attachments section on Unstop.

Important PPT Submission Guidelines:

  • Only the official CIH 4.0 PPT Template is permitted.
  • Do not modify its prescribed structure, design or format.
  • Submissions using other templates or unauthorized modifications may lead to disqualification.

PPT Submission Deadline: 30 November 2026

Phase 2: Virtual Round - Idea Presentation

Dates: 15 December - 25 December 2026

  • Registered teams will present their proposed ideas virtually.
  • Teams must explain their problem statement, innovation and technical approach.
  • Judges and mentors will evaluate innovation, technical feasibility, scalability and real-world impact.
  • Shortlisted teams will qualify for the Offline Grand Finale.

Phase 3: Grand Finale 24-Hour Offline Hackathon

Dates: 22-23 January 2027

Venue: Suryodaya College of Engineering & Technology, Nagpur, Maharashtra.

Selected teams will participate in an intensive 24-hour Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon.

Grand Finale Participation Fee: ₹1,500 per shortlisted team, payable only after selection to confirm participation. The amount will cover food and accommodation arrangements.

Activities Include:

  • Team verification and official inauguration.
  • On-the-spot Deep-Tech Problem Statements.
  • 24-hour intensive development challenge.
  • Prototype development and implementation.
  • Technical mentorship and expert guidance.
  • Final project presentation and live demonstration.
  • Jury evaluation and winner announcement.

Prize Pool

₹1,00,000 + Goodies

Outstanding teams will be rewarded for innovation, technical excellence and real-world impact. Detailed prize distribution will be announced through official event platforms.

Be Part of History!

CIH 4.0 aims to bring together innovators from across India for an ambitious Largest Deep-Tech Innovation Hackathon record attempt, seeking recognition from the International Book of Records.

Register your team, submit your idea and take the first step towards building something extraordinary.

Be a Part of History. Be a Part of CIH 4.0!
